authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't become a generic Grixis combo shell; the infinite should be commander-native combat.
Don't add non-artifact creatures that the counter mode ignores without reason.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Random modes miss what the board needs.
mitigations: More triggers average out the variance

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Cult dies attacking or to removal.
Almost no tutors (Inventors' Fair only for artifacts; Urza's Saga finds 0-1 cost artifacts), so the Sword + Assault combo is found by drawing.

value.interaction: Counters (Mana Drain) and flexible removal (Delete, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift).
value.mana: Artifact mana (Mox Opal, Mana Vault, Urza's Saga) for extra-combat turns.
value.protection: Greaves, Boots, Padeem, Plaza; the engine needs Cult to survive attacking.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Every Cult attack produces value; Helm tokens, extra combats and copies each roll another trigger.
accepted_role.honest_note: The mode is random and fixed when the trigger goes on the stack, so the engine is high-variance; copies repeat the rolled mode, extra triggers re-roll.
